title: Session progress - PyTorch DLL fix complete
content:
- Bug: `/api/system` endpoint returned 500 Internal Server Error on Windows when PyTorch's DLL init failed (WinError 1114)
- Root cause: `import torch` raises `OSError`, not `ImportError`, but only `except ImportError:` was catching it
- Fix applied: Changed `except ImportError:` to `except (ImportError, OSError):` at line 112 of src/litert_studio/server/app.py
- Verified: App creates successfully with all 30 routes registered
- Other torch imports in reference.py, merge.py, transformers_backend.py are function-level inside job workers — appropriate behavior since those jobs require torch to actually run
